tooltip.quantumitems.window.shared: Shares one pool of items with its twins - use any, drain all.
tooltip.quantumitems.window.ground: Touching the ground breaks the link: the whole pool spills out here.
tooltip.quantumitems.window.automation: Machines extract ordinary items; taking the last one ends the link.
tooltip.quantumitems.window.shulker: Sleeps safely inside a shulker box. What you find on waking depends on the pool.
tooltip.quantumitems.shard.lore: A splinter of somewhere else. It remembers being two places at once.
tooltip.quantumitems.shard.source: Found where the old city sleeps in the dark.
quantumitems.ponder.tag.quantum_entangle: Entangle stacks so distant windows share one pool of items.
quantumitems.ponder.circle.text_1: A five-by-five floor of Amethyst holds the ritual together
quantumitems.ponder.circle.text_2: Four Resonators stand on the corners - pedestals that each hold one stack
quantumitems.ponder.circle.text_3: The Quantum Core, two blocks tall, presides at the centre
quantumitems.ponder.circle.text_4: Keep the circle clean: no stray blocks in the space above the floor
quantumitems.ponder.ritual.text_1: Lay one stack on every resonator - all four must match
quantumitems.ponder.ritual.text_2: Place a Quantum Shard on the core to begin - it is consumed either way
quantumitems.ponder.ritual.text_3: The core reaches out to each resonator in turn
quantumitems.ponder.ritual.text_4: If the pattern holds, a golden verdict names the winning corner
quantumitems.ponder.ritual.text_5: The circle builds to a crescendo, then the entanglement snaps into place
quantumitems.ponder.ritual.text_6: Now those stacks are one pool, shared across any distance
quantumitems.ponder.ritual.text_7: A broken pattern instead ends in a loud collapse - and the shard is still spent
quantumitems.ponder.shared_pool.text_1: Two entangled windows can sit anywhere - even in chests at opposite ends
quantumitems.ponder.shared_pool.text_2: They do not each hold items - they are two views of a single shared pool
quantumitems.ponder.shared_pool.text_3: Take from one and the other empties too. Nothing is ever duplicated
